name: Sophy Banks
reason: Not mainly a spiritual teacher: her own site (healthyhumanculture.com, a team brand) presents her as a facilitator of culture-change, systems and grief-tending work built on psychotherapy, neuroscience and trauma frameworks, and much of the material is framed around trauma, burnout and conflict, so few items would pass the health-claim rule. Her listed events (Sept–Oct 2026) have passed, there is no personal email (only a Squarespace contact page) and the Sharpham burnout retreat is condition-led. The queue already marked her as borderline activist and facilitator.
